title: App watchdog: interrupt and resume a turn whose model request has had no answer for 15 minutes
notes: From card 17f24de6's finding: API_TIMEOUT_MS only bounds the headers wait, and the CLI's own watchdogs (300s stall, 361s no answer) already retry; the night's 00:23-02:35 hang sat below them (no retry recorded anywhere, VPN had no route to host). Wanted: when a session the app runs (worker pane or main) has sent a request and nothing came back for ~15 min, the app interrupts the turn and resumes it, reusing the resume path from card 2fc8d59f. See the comment on 17f24de6 for the test results.
